column2: A savage demon who serves the Ice Apostle. It loves to fight and kills anyone who defies it on sight.[end]
A beast demon who serves the Flame Apostle. It can change shape, and was disguised as Zebul.[end]

A lion demon who serves the Flame Apostle. It can change shape, and was disguised as Berith.[end]
A demon of living flame who serves the Ice Apostle. It's not great at talking, and not very smart.[end]

A mysterious demon with a lost ancient power. Skilled in magic and combat, it's rumored to have never lost a fight...[end]
A demon knight in crimson armor who rides a red horse and attacks foes with fearsome swordplay.[end]
A cheerful demon with a sturdy body that sticks out its big tongue and laughs. It loves babies and will guard them with its life.[end]
